text: さいきん　ポケモン　タワーに　ゆうれいが　でる　らしいんだ…　どうも　ロケットだんに　ころされた　ポケモンの　ゆうれい　らしい…

structure.jp: さいきん　ポケモン　タワーに　ゆうれいが　でる　らしいんだ…
structure.en: lately, it seems ghosts appear in Pokémon Tower...

structure.jp: どうも　ロケットだんに　ころされた　ポケモンの　ゆうれい　らしい…
structure.en: apparently they're ghosts of Pokémon killed by Team Rocket...

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい at the end says this is what the speaker has heard, not something he knows first-hand. でる らしい = 'apparently they appear'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: ロケットだんに　ころされた
patterns.explanation: This verb shape says the action was done to someone, and に shows who did it. ロケットだんに ころされた = 'were killed by Team Rocket'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ロケットだんに　ころされた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in a verb comes right before the noun and describes it. ロケットだんに ころされた ポケモン = 'Pokémon that were killed by Team Rocket'.
